title: TV Tables
text:
TV Tables. The style and design of the tables is very nice. I like it

However, the packaging was not great, on each of the 4 tables there are noticable scratches and gouges in the table tops. Each table was covered with a plastic bag. No bubble wrap. it seems they were not packed for shipping.
Disappointing to get the tables damaged.

product_metadata.title: Winsome Oversize Snack Table Set, Walnut
features: Category: Bed Tray and Snack Table
description: Great for keeping in dining room, kitchen or game room, the Daryyl 5pc snack Table Set is great to have for work and play time. With rectangular tops, these wood TV Tables can easily hold a large meal with style. An upright stand stores them when not in use.
